summary: Reviewed the complete implementation and generated integrations against all nine acceptance criteria. Fixed the discovered request-return race, post-approval spec mutation, concurrent state/spec split, unsupported future-event handling, lock ownership and abandoned recovery behavior, Codex MCP working-directory override, symlink replacement, and file-mode preservation. Final TypeScript checks, 28 tests with 143 assertions, built Node CLI/MCP/loop smoke test, and npm package dry run all pass with no remaining blocking finding.
